title.narrative: UN Development Coordination Office (UNDCO) Core Contribution 2022-2023 to 2024-2025

description.narrative: A multi-year funding agreement for the reinvigorated United Nations (UN) Resident Coordinator (RC) system, RCs play a vital role in leading and coordinating whole-of-UN responses at the country level, including at moments of conflict, crisis and instability (e.g., Ukraine, Afghanistan, Myanmar and PNG). The reinvigorated RC system has enhanced authority, independence and dedicated funding, and aims to improve coherence across UN agencies. Since 2019, Australia has contributed AUD5 million to the UN Development Coordination Office (UNDCO) Special Purpose Trust Fund demonstrating our support for improvements to the UN development system, and for the developing countries that will benefit. Renewing a multi-year funding arrangement will preserve the positive momentum and ensure stable and predictable resourcing for reform. The total value of this investment is $6.0 million, to be expensed over three years commencing in the 2022-23 financial year.
